text: [excited] Righto! I got this! Overnight, three stations on the Bremer went quiet at ten past two. [laughs] Billy's up! Tea?

name: turbo-v4-turbo-fast
text: [quickly] And it was a wet week! Thursday was the wettest, nearly four hundred gauges reporting rain. Personal best! Race ya!

name: alex-v2
text: Alex Chen, on the radio side. Every transmitter has a carrier of its own, a fingerprint. That's not a fault, that's a symptom.
